title: Recent Release, "Almost Home," from Page Publishing Author Stephanie Jorden, Brings a Paranormal Romance Where a Grieving Woman and Restless Ghost Share Space

content:
Chicago, IL, September 30, 2026 --(PR.com)-- Stephanie Jorden has completed a new book, "Almost Home": A Living with Spirit Paranormal Romance that begins when Shelby Jones, fresh from a broken engagement, purchases a beautifully renovated Victorian home seeking solitude and fresh starts. What she doesn't anticipate is that her sanctuary is already inhabited by Simon Moretti, a charismatic architect who designed the very renovations that drew her to the property. Trapped between worlds since his tragic death in 1988, Simon has been waiting for someone who could understand him, and Shelby's arrival restores something in him he thought lost forever: the ability to connect with another person.

Stephanie Jorden, a Chicago-based writer with extensive experience in television and film, brings her signature talent for witty dialogue and authentic emotion to this paranormal romance. Her background in comedic writing and dramatic storytelling shines throughout the narrative. She studied at Second City's Training Program and honed her craft through numerous screenwriting accolades, including a nomination for the Gordon Parks Award. She found the Living with Spirit characters so compelling that she transformed her television scripts into this engaging novella series that blends humor with heartache.

In "Almost Home," readers will discover a richly layered story about two souls separated by time and circumstance who must navigate their conflicting desires; Shelby wants Simon gone, but he refuses to leave, especially now that he can finally touch someone again after decades of isolation. As their struggle intensifies into something far more intimate, both characters confront deeper questions of what it truly means to be home and whether love can exist across the boundary between the living and the dead. The stakes grow personal and profound as each discovers that helping the other find peace might require the ultimate sacrifice.
"I wanted to explore the idea that sometimes the person who can help us heal is the one we least expect to meet," said Jorden. "Shelby and Simon's journey became a story about acceptance, second chances, and recognizing that home isn't always about a place.”

Published by Page Publishing, Stephanie Jorden's captivating work offers readers an enchanting blend of paranormal intrigue and romantic tension that will resonate long after the final page. This paranormal romance proves that the most transformative relationships often arrive when we're least prepared to welcome them.

Readers who wish to experience this spellbinding work can purchase "Almost Home" at bookstores everywhere, or online at the Apple iTunes Store, Amazon, Google Play, or Barnes and Noble.
